name: @nuxeo-satori/studio-migration
$tagsComment: A Node tool, and nothing may import it: no depConstraint in eslint.config.mjs lists `type:tool`. It imports one project of the workspace, libs/shared/app-definition, whose validators it writes configuration packages for and checks them with (harness check 10); its own rule there lets it use shared code and the core, and nothing else.

test.$inputsComment: nx.json's test inputs, plus the files a test holds this tool to, so that an edit to one reruns the test rather than replaying a cached pass: the extension reference, whose slot table the catalogue's app slots are held to, and the new app's pages whose own rows lab mode's table copies (lab.spec.ts).

lint.$comment: Declared rather than inferred: @nx/eslint/plugin infers `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does not match (see tools/satori-generators/project.json).

typecheck.$comment: Nothing else type-checks this project: `spec-typecheck.mjs` reads only `apps/` and `libs/`, and Vitest strips types without checking them. The config includes the specs.
